description: Graded relevance judgments for the 8 validation queries of F05-v1 against the 5 documents of arrival 0 (40 pairs). Declared by the authoring agent under rule RJ-1 on invented text. Provisional until the learner reviews every grade in the notebook's review cell.
unanswerable_policy: a query with no grade >= 1 is unanswerable: recall@k, reciprocal rank and nDCG are undefined for it and excluded from means; precision@k is reported; its ranked list is printed

fields.query_id: F05-v1 validation query ID (vq1 to vq8)
fields.grade: relevance grade under RJ-1: 2 = holds the query's answer span (ES-1); 1 = about the query's task and holds no answer span; 0 = otherwise
fields.reason: the clause of RJ-1 that produced the grade
